node.statement: Case V_n={0}: every Z in V_n equals 0. Since T_n is the linear amplification of the Ha-map, T_n(0)=0, and therefore ||T_n(Z)||=0>=(1-C_diag*e)||Z||=0. Thus the root contract at this fixed level n is already proved, and neither a_n nor any infimum over nonzero vectors is formed in this case.
